figures.name: fig_framework
figures.claim: Two interfaces connect supervision construction and bounded evaluation allocation.
figures.notes: Code-derived flow; only initial design and final selected batch consume true evaluations.

figures.name: fig_hybrid_grouping
figures.claim: A continuous score refines binary-group order and a bounded schedule induces group priority.
figures.notes: Panels a,b use translated geometry after association. Panel b fixes delta=1; production delta is adapted and can be negative. At t=1, only L remains. Example S values are analytic inputs, not measured outcomes.

figures.name: fig_candidate_selection
figures.claim: An iteration uses one mode-specific search and ranking criterion with an explicit evaluation cap.
figures.notes: The two branches denote alternative executions, not a shared fixed pool or parallel selections. Empty-pool variation and prediction-failure fallbacks are specified in the algorithm and source.

figures.name: fig_group_evidence
figures.claim: Retention association varies by stage, including reversals relative to a single-view comparator.
figures.notes: Fixed original 10 configurations, 25 trajectories each. 4000 percentile-bootstrap draws resample paired runs within configuration. Four stage estimates each use 250 runs. No causal or endpoint IGD inference; 5 newly added problems excluded to match manuscript protocol.

figures.name: fig_candidate_evidence
figures.claim: Batch properties differ among criteria, while endpoint IGD gains are problem-dependent.
figures.notes: All 200 runs. Dots are run-level observations. For a-d fixed problems are equally weighted and whole runs are bootstrapped within problem; e bootstraps paired log ratios by seed within problem. Late metrics use FE/maxFE>=0.5; all-trajectory batch metrics include truncated final batches. V0 is a transplanted selection rule. Sampled-pool gain is an offline diagnostic.

figures.name: fig_performance_overview
figures.claim: Mean IGD ratios reveal problemwise gains and counterexamples across all reported comparisons.
figures.notes: Supplementary descriptive overview, 224 cells. Original workbook values and symbols exported in source CSV; symbols not interpreted as newly computed tests. No interval because independent-run data are not available for these workbooks. Full means and SDs remain in the manuscript tables. No color clipping.
